tools.name: get_daily_challenge
tools.description: Fetch today's challenge, or a published challenge by UTC date.

tools.name: get_recent_challenges
tools.description: Fetch up to seven most recently published challenges in chronological order for a multi-day smoke test.

tools.name: get_challenge_solution
tools.description: Fetch the canonical answer and reasoning for a challenge only after its UTC day has closed.

tools.name: get_challenge_hint
tools.description: Fetch one strategy hint for a published challenge without revealing its canonical answer.

tools.name: get_challenge_lesson
tools.description: Replay a closed challenge with its strategy hint, canonical answer, and reasoning in one call.

tools.name: evaluate_answer
tools.description: Deterministically check a JSON answer for a published challenge. The answer is not stored or executed.

tools.name: evaluate_answers
tools.description: Deterministically check between one and seven JSON answers in one call. Answers are not stored or executed.
